rust_summary: a player starting and stopping tracking an entity (`native_player_start_tracking`, `native_player_stop_tracking`).
doc_summary: a player's client starting and stopping tracking an entity, on the single player server thread and on a dedicated server: `native_player_start_tracking(player, name, entity, uuid, kind)` when the entity is sent to the player (NeoForge's `PlayerEvent.StartTracking`, vanilla's `ServerEntity.addPairing`) and `native_player_stop_tracking(...)` when it stops (`PlayerEvent.StopTracking`, `removePairing`): out of range, gone from the level, or the player left, changed level or respawned. They name the entity by ID, UUID and type and run with no player's state swapped in, so a mod sends what the player needs with `native_net_send_to_player`. Each start has one stop. Bundles that use them need "hooks": @API:player_tracking@.
